statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-13506 (GHSA-qp49-qgx5-5m26): in Bouncy Castle, forcing a lazily parsed ASN.1 sequence resets the guard that limits how deeply nested input is parsed. For Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS (bc-fips) 2.1.x it is fixed in 2.1.3 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qp49-qgx5-5m26, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%9013506). Covered every package of this owner published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repositories: eclipse-temurin-11-jre-fips on x86_64 (16 versions, 11.0.30.7-r0 to 11.0.33.10-r1) and aarch64 (8 versions, 11.0.30.7-r0 to 11.0.31.11-r6, the same Bouncy Castle files as the x86_64 packages of those versions), eclipse-temurin-11-jre on x86_64 (the same 16 versions; none is published for aarch64), and the oci-config packages. Read the bundle version from the manifest of every Bouncy Castle jar in every published package of this owner, recursing into nested archives. Bouncy Castle is in the eclipse-temurin-11-jre-fips package, as /usr/lib/bouncycastle/bc-fips-<version>.jar next to the bcpkix-fips, bctls-fips, bcutil-fips and bc-rng-jent jars. The eclipse-temurin-11-jre packages hold no Bouncy Castle classes, in jrt-fs.jar or in the runtime image lib/modules, and the eclipse-temurin-11-jre-oci-config packages hold no jars. bc-fips is 2.1.2 in 11.0.30.7-r0 to 11.0.32.1.1-r0 and in 11.0.32.9-r0, and 2.1.3 in 11.0.32.1.1-r1 and in 11.0.32.9.1.1-r2 and every later build. Under apk version ordering 11.0.32.9-r0 sorts between those two fixed builds, so the range has two spans: affected below 11.0.32.1.1-r1, fixed from 11.0.32.1.1-r1, affected again from 11.0.32.9-r0, and fixed from 11.0.32.9.1.1-r2.

CVE-2026-13506 (GHSA-qp49-qgx5-5m26): in Bouncy Castle, forcing a lazily parsed ASN.1 sequence resets the guard that limits how deeply nested input is parsed. For Bouncy Castle for Java FIPS, bc-fips 2.1.x before 2.1.3 is affected and 2.1.3 carries the fix: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qp49-qgx5-5m26, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%9013506. The DHI eclipse-temurin-21-jre packages for Alpine 3.23 ship Bouncy Castle FIPS in their eclipse-temurin-21-jre-fips subpackage, as /usr/lib/bouncycastle/bc-fips-<version>.jar. Read the manifest of every jar in every published eclipse-temurin-21-jre-fips package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository (18 versions, 21.0.10.7-r0 to 21.0.13.9.1.2-r0; x86_64 and aarch64). The bc-fips jar is 2.1.2 in 21.0.10.7-r0 to 21.0.12.1.1-r0 and 21.0.12.8-r0, and 2.1.3 in 21.0.12.1.1-r1, and in 21.0.12.8.1.1-r2 and every later build. 21.0.12.8-r0 sorts after 21.0.12.1.1-r1 but went back to bc-fips 2.1.2, so the range closes at 21.0.12.1.1-r1, reopens at 21.0.12.8-r0 and closes again at 21.0.12.8.1.1-r2, the next build with 2.1.3.
